question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Corroborate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Support**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"corroborate"** means to confirm or give support to a statement, theory, or finding. (पुष्टि करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The witness was able to corroborate the suspect's alibi.
 
 
 
• **"Support"** means to bear all or part of the weight of; hold up or give assistance to, especially financially. (सहायता करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The data supports the hypothesis put forward by the researchers.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'corroborate' **is **'support'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Support**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Suggest **(सुझाव देना): To propose a solution, hypothesis, or other possible answer.
 
 
• **Example:** I suggest we meet earlier to discuss the project.
 
 
 
• **Contend **(वाद-विवाद करना): To struggle to surmount (a difficulty or danger) or to assert something as a position in an argument.
 
 
• **Example: **He contends that the judge was wrong in his decision.
 
 
 
• **Elaborate **(विस्तार से बताना): To explain in more detail.
 
 
• **Example:** Can you elaborate on your plan for the new project?

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
